decisionConsequence: Scarcity clearly creates information-selection value and low-noise policies exploit it, but the current two-inspection thesis is not robust enough under the predeclared bounded-rational player model to earn product commitment. Retain the mechanism evidence; do not promote this product thesis to G0 without a new product thesis or materially different evidence basis.
boundary: This is a model-relative robustness result and does not identify Human fairness, satisfaction or aha experience.
